received.note: Across nine commercial banks, per the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers. A further USD 6.11 million sits in dollar accounts at Himalayan Bank and Laxmi Bank, not included here.

dispatched.note: Mobilised, not yet spent. The Fund Management Committee decided on 1 September to move Rs 1 billion out of the PM fund’s Everest Bank account into the Disaster Management Fund held by the Home Secretary under Section 22 of the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act 2017. It is allocated onward only as District Disaster Management Committees request it, so the money below is what has actually reached local units. Radio Nepal put the remaining PM fund balance at Rs 536 crore the same day.

recovery_estimate.note: Preliminary estimate of $4–5 billion to rebuild, cited by Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle.
